opening.text: I was shot in the face and needed life-saving surgery and reconstruction. My jaw was shattered near the joint, and the broken pieces were set in an operation. After that, my left jaw joint was replaced with an artificial joint. I can hardly open my mouth since my injury and operations. I also have a headache. It's an aching pain. During the flare-ups my left eye waters. During the flare-ups my nose keeps running. I have a burning, tingling feeling over my left cheekbone. My left eyelid droops. My left eye looks red.
